supporting_observations.claim: At 13:47 UTC, ali.hassan created the domain account helpdesk2.
About one minute later, ali.hassan added helpdesk2 to the Administrators group.

The account name and privileged group membership are inconsistent with the stated help-desk process: temporary accounts use the temp.<name> pattern, belong only to Externals, and never receive administrator rights. This makes the alerted account activity strongly suspicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records establish that ali.hassan was recorded as the actor, but do not establish who was operating the account or whether the action had an approved change.
The account-management records do not identify the originating workstation or the command or tool used to create and elevate the account.
claims_not_established: Whether helpdesk2 was created under an authorized exception or change.
Whether ali.hassan's credentials were used by ali.hassan or by another person.
Whether helpdesk2 was subsequently used to access systems or perform other actions.
additional_evidence_needed: Check change approvals and account-provisioning records for helpdesk2 and its Administrators membership.
Retrieve domain-controller logon and process auditing around the account changes to identify the originating host, session, and method.
Review helpdesk2's subsequent sign-ins, group memberships, and activity; preserve the account and relevant logs pending investigation.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation: ali.hassan logged on interactively to WS-NKIM-01 from 198.51.100.201, an origin inconsistent with the stated remote-administration practice; the records show an inbound connection to port 3389 and a successful logon. This is not, by itself, proof of who performed the alerted account changes. Records: T167-00095, T167-00096, T167-00097, T167-00098.

Separate investigation: a scheduled task registered on WS-NKIM-01 under ali.hassan launches hidden PowerShell with an encoded command that decodes to a web request for a script from 198.51.100.201. This is suspicious but is not used to decide the account-management alert. Record: T167-00126.

Separate investigation: Google Drive File Stream ran under noah.kim on WS-NKIM-01; the inventory lists Microsoft 365 / OneDrive as approved cloud storage and does not list Google Drive. Records: T167-00038, T167-00039, T167-00040.
